Second step of the labor-reallocation act slice (ADR 0029): records an approval of one proposed move with its confirmation token and approver, and delegates the assignment to workforce-management assign_labor. An expired token is a 410. This route replaces POST .../\{proposalId\}/approve (ADR 0031): the old verb route is not part of this contract; it still answers, keyless and unchanged, with the headers Deprecation, Sunset (Wed, 10 Feb 2027 00:00:00 GMT) and Link rel="successor-version" until that date.
